description: Speech to text: transcribe an audio file, or the audio track of a video, with nemotron-3.5-transcribe. Returns the full text, the audio duration and a transcript_url (the complete result as JSON, kept 30 days). With timestamps: true that JSON also has word-level start / end times and speaker labels (up to 8 speakers). With target_language the speech is translated instead of transcribed. $0.0025 per audio minute ($0.15 per hour), billed by the second; timestamps, speaker labels and translation cost nothing extra; failed jobs, and files whose length cannot be read, are not billed. Limits: up to 60 minutes and 200 MB per file; mp3, wav, m4a, aac, flac, ogg, opus, webm, or mp4 / mov with an audio track. Offline, whole-file transcription — no realtime / streaming. A local file is uploaded for you first, and that upload is limited to 10 MB for audio files and 100 MB for video files — for anything larger, put the file at a public URL and pass the URL. A short clip finishes in seconds (a 47-second recording took about 8 s); a long recording may come back as a task id — call get_task with it, do not resubmit.

audio_url.description: The audio (or video with an audio track) to transcribe: a public https:// URL that downloads directly, a LOCAL FILE PATH, a localhost URL or a data: URI — local sources are uploaded for you (audio up to 10 MB, video up to 100 MB).

model.description: Speech-to-text model id. nemotron-3.5-transcribe is the only one for now.

target_language.description: Translate the speech into this language instead of transcribing it. Only translation to or from English is guaranteed. Cannot be combined with timestamps: true.

timestamps.description: true: the JSON at transcript_url also carries word-level start / end times and speaker labels (up to 8 speakers). Default false. Cannot be combined with target_language.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the transcript before returning a task id instead (seconds, 0–900). Default 50: Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s unless tool_timeout_sec is raised. In Claude Code / Claude Desktop you can pass up to 900 to get the URL in one call.

name: transcribe_audio
